keyCharacteristics: Three materials: cover board (header band, sheet headers, unlock card), graphite (terminal and key rows), paper (prompt field, sheets, toast).
Rubber stamps for run state, re-inked per surface for contrast.
One 4px spacing module; every gap is a multiple of it.
Cobalt is the loud third colour: it means pressable, and it marks the run.
Code-led: inline SVG stroke icons, CSS stamps and ruling, self-hosted webfonts; no rasters.

rules.name: The Two Main Colours Rule
rules.body: Every surface is gold or ivory, or a step of one. A new surface picks one of the two; navy never becomes a surface.

rules.name: The Navy Contrast Rule
rules.body: Navy is the contrast colour: ink, the run marks (clock, run fill, stamps), hairlines and every pressable. It stays scarce so it keeps popping. Red and green are status ink only and never decorate.

rules.name: The Re-Inked Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp red has one meaning and three inks; pick the ink by the surface it lands on (stamp-red on gold, stamp-red-paper on paper, stamp-red-light on keys), never the other way round.

rules.name: The Numerals-Are-Condensed Rule
rules.body: Every count, clock and readout is Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals, so digits never jitter as they tick.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Terminal Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks text that is, or will be sent to, the shell (snippets, slash commands, copied output). Prose never sets in mono.

rules.name: The One Press Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every pressable carries the same soft press shadow and drops 1px on press; nothing else on the key rows has a shadow.

dos: keep navy (#0E1D61) for ink, run marks and pressables only; surfaces are gold or ivory.
pick the stamp-red ink by surface: #5c1810 on gold, #a93624 on paper and keys.
build every gap from the 4px module and keep touch targets 44-48px.
set every count, clock and readout in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals.
use dashed borders to mean "not yet" or "off" (READY, muted, Pin).
let the stamp press-in be the only authored motion; other transitions stay at 100-280ms ease-out and honor reduced motion.
donts: add a status dot or a blue accent; state is a stamp on the cover band.
introduce a fourth surface tint beyond cover, graphite and paper.
use rule-green for decoration; it divides measured data only.
set prose in monospace, or terminal text in Barlow.
let command rows wrap; one name line, one ellipsized note line.
change terminal columns for the phone; font size fits, columns stay pinned to the PTY.
